description: Test support functions for typing lease mechanisms, including pulse creation, lease management, and failure handling, using Vitest testing framework.

methods.name: asMockedPulse
methods.description: Type assertion to treat a pulse as a MockedPulse object.

methods.name: expectTypingPulseCount
methods.description: Checks that the pulse mock has been called the expected number of times.

methods.name: createPulseWithBackgroundFailure
methods.description: Creates a mock pulse function that throws an error on the second call to simulate background failure.

methods.name: expectIndependentTypingLeases
methods.description: Tests that multiple leases operate independently and pulse correctly over simulated time.

methods.name: expectBackgroundTypingPulseFailuresAreSwallowed
methods.description: Verifies that background pulse failures are handled gracefully without propagating errors.

methods.name: registerSharedTypingLeaseTests
methods.description: Registers shared tests for lease behavior, including immediate pulsing and failure handling.

methods.name: expectDefaultTypingLeaseInterval
methods.description: Checks that the default interval for typing leases is respected when intervalMs is not set.
